In all 56 models the bytes between the name pool end and the next 16-byte boundary are zero, and every file size is a multiple of 16.
The words at the aligned geometry start follow a stable structure that is the same in every model.
The mesh geometry of the models has been decoded.
The milestone-#2 model contract reports this field as an unresolved count, so the new command records the finding separately instead of changing that contract.
All 56 tests pass and pyright reports zero errors on the new files.

SOURCE of check_model, applied to every .ps2 model by verify_model.py corpus (any violation raises Invalid and is recorded as a failure, so status pass means none occurred):
def check_model(data: bytes) -> dict:
    tree = model(data)
    pool_end = max(name["end"] for name in tree["names"])
    leading = tree["leading_count"]
    if leading != pool_end:
        raise Invalid(f"leading u32 {leading} differs from name pool end {pool_end}")
    if len(data) % 16:
        raise Invalid(f"size {len(data)} is not a multiple of 16")
    start = -(-pool_end // 16) * 16
    if any(data[pool_end:start]):
        raise Invalid(f"padding between the name pool end {pool_end} and {start} is not zero")
    return {
        "name_pool_end": pool_end,
        "geometry_region_start": start,
        "pad_length": start - pool_end,
        "geometry_bytes": len(data) - start,
        "geometry_sha256": sha256(data[start:]),
        "names": len(tree["names"]),
        "groups": len(tree["groups"]),
        "unresolved": UNRESOLVED,
    }
